title: Absalom Kills Amnon at the Sheep Shearing
description: Two years after Amnon had violated Tamar, Absalom arranged a sheep-shearing festival in Baal-Hazor and invited all the king's sons. He ordered his servants to kill Amnon when he became merry with wine. After the murder, the other king's sons fled, and a false rumor reached David that all his sons were dead. Jonadab explained that only Amnon had been killed. Absalom fled to Talmai in Geshur, where he stayed for three years, while David mourned.
